lookback_summary: Well, last weekend certainly had its surprises! The model nailed the predictions for Aston Villa against Nottingham Forest and Crystal Palace versus Ipswich Town, both resulting in away wins. However, it had to eat humble pie with Chelsea and Liverpool, who both ended up in draws when the model had them as bankers for home wins. On the flip side, it got Sunderland's match against Arsenal right, predicting an away win, and it also correctly called the draw in Tottenham's fixture against Everton. Overall, a mixed bag but some solid calls!
